skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of information technology, including computer hardware and software, operating systems, and common applications such as Microsoft Office and Python programming.
Describe and explain the components of a computer system, including CPU, input/output systems, and memory organization.
Operate and manage tasks in Windows operating system and use common applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Understand and implement basic programming concepts in Python, including data types, expressions, and control structures.
Develop problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and in teams.
Enhance critical thinking and the ability to self-study and understand related computer systems and programming concepts.
Improve communication skills through presentations and group discussions.
Work effectively in teams to complete group assignments and projects.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and manage personal study time.
